exceptions.reason: Outline-only topics are contextual labels; no unsupported detailed sampling/statistics/proposal questions are invented.
Blank enrichment forms require personal/student input; no fixed answer key is supplied.

Malformed formula glyphs are not scored as exact mathematics. The separate reliability deck supplies readable formulas; the split-half administration contradiction is explicitly tested with a clarification.
The genetic-method paragraph conflicts with its heading. A source-specific heading question and comparison note cover it without inventing a reconciled definition.

Exact reconstruction of the ambiguous separate-sample X layout is excluded; readable prose is tested. The extra X in the nonequivalent control row is explicitly identified and a corrected schematic is labeled.

reviewMethod: Text extraction plus visual inspection of all 75 image-based pages and formula/diagram close-ups. Source text is paraphrased into authored questions; diagrams are transcribed and labeled.
